For more information and to order stereo imagery products, please refer to the GEO Stereo Imagery Order Form.

  • Time of Capture: May 6th - June 10th, 2016
  • Number of Images: 356 lines 
  • Resolution: 18 centimetre (RGBN)
  • Bit-depth: 16-bit 
  • Number of bands: Four band (RGBN) 
  • Format: TIFF (SocetSet model setup) 
  • Camera(s):  Leica ADS100 line based

For more information on the Central Ontario Orthophotography Project (COOP) 2016 please see the main COOP 2016 GeoHub record. 

 
Available Products: 
Stereo Frames
